paragraphs.zh: 进一步的，步骤2)中所述溶剂为乙腈、DMF、丙酮或四氢呋喃；反应温度为0～80℃。
paragraphs.en: Further, the solvent described in step 2) is acetonitrile, DMF, acetone or tetrahydrofuran; the reaction temperature is 0 to 80 degrees C.
paragraphs.notes: Provenance: the zh field was transcribed from the PDF's own embedded text layer (CN109678767A is born digital, not scanned), not read off pixels. The rendered image was used only to confirm layout and line breaks. The step number closes with a half-width ')' as encoded. The range mark is the wave dash '～' (U+FF5E), not a hyphen, and the degree-Celsius sign is the single character '℃' (U+2103); both preserved as encoded. This paragraph constrains step 2) only and gives no reagent, so it cannot be cross-checked against a drawn reagent.

paragraphs.zh: 优选的，步骤3)中，2-氯-3-(2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸、催化剂、氯化亚砜、1,3-环己二酮、三乙胺、丙酮氰醇的摩尔比为1:0.01～0.1:1～2:1～2:2～3:0.01～0.1。
paragraphs.en: Preferably, in step 3), the molar ratio of 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid, catalyst, thionyl chloride, 1,3-cyclohexanedione, triethylamine and acetone cyanohydrin is 1:0.01-0.1:1-2:1-2:2-3:0.01-0.1.
paragraphs.notes: Provenance: the zh field was transcribed from the PDF's own embedded text layer (CN109678767A is born digital, not scanned), not read off pixels. The rendered image was used only to confirm layout and line breaks. SPACING, recorded verbatim and NOT corrected: the text layer encodes the trifluoroethoxy locants as '(2 ,2 ,2-' with a space BEFORE each comma, while the very same paragraph encodes the dione locants as '1,3-' with no spaces at all. The printed page shows no such asymmetry, so the spaces are a text-layer glyph-advance artifact and downstream passes must not read meaning into them. LINE BREAKS: this paragraph occupies three printed lines (page y 227-257, 276-306, 330-352); the text layer stores them as three lines and they have been joined here with no inserted whitespace, per CJK convention. CONTENT: six components in the ratio, so the six colon-separated fields map as acid 1, catalyst 0.01-0.1, thionyl chloride 1-2, 1,3-cyclohexanedione 1-2, triethylamine 2-3, acetone cyanohydrin 0.01-0.1. This is the only paragraph on the page that names reagents, and it is the anchor for every cross-check against the scheme.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步的，步骤3)中，三乙胺的滴加温度为0～30℃。
paragraphs.en: Further, in step 3), the dropwise addition temperature of triethylamine is 0 to 30 degrees C.
paragraphs.notes: Provenance: the zh field was transcribed from the PDF's own embedded text layer (CN109678767A is born digital, not scanned), not read off pixels. The rendered image was used only to confirm layout and line breaks. 滴加 means addition dropwise, so triethylamine is the component metered in rather than charged at once. No temperature appears anywhere on the drawn scheme, so this figure has no counterpart to check against.

paragraphs.zh: 进一步的，步骤3)中，催化剂为DMF；结晶溶剂为甲醇、乙醇、异丙醇或正丁醇。
paragraphs.en: Further, in step 3), the catalyst is DMF; the crystallisation solvent is methanol, ethanol, isopropanol or n-butanol.
paragraphs.notes: Provenance: the zh field was transcribed from the PDF's own embedded text layer (CN109678767A is born digital, not scanned), not read off pixels. The rendered image was used only to confirm layout and line breaks. This identifies the 催化剂 (catalyst) of [0025] as DMF. DMF is not drawn anywhere on the scheme; see discrepancies. 结晶溶剂 is the crystallisation (workup) solvent, distinct from a reaction solvent.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明所涉及的反应方程式如下：
paragraphs.en: The reaction equations involved in the present invention are as follows:
paragraphs.notes: Provenance: the zh field was transcribed from the PDF's own embedded text layer (CN109678767A is born digital, not scanned), not read off pixels. The rendered image was used only to confirm layout and line breaks. This sentence is the attribution marker for the drawing that follows: 本发明所涉及的 = 'involved in the present invention'. The scheme below is therefore the INVENTION'S OWN route and not prior art, and every drawing on this page inherits that attribution. Ends with the full-width colon '：'.

The marker [0029] is printed alone in the left margin at page coordinates x 187-262, y 1293-1318, with no text after it. It is the paragraph slot that HOLDS the reaction scheme: the drawing block spans page y 526-2088 whose vertical centre is y 1307, and the marker's own vertical centre is y 1306, so the marker is centred against the whole block rather than sitting above it. That is why it appears visually beside the third drawn reaction; it does not belong to that reaction. The text layer likewise shows [0029] followed by nothing, because the scheme is a graphic and carries no characters the text layer can hold. Everything recorded under 'drawings' below is the content of this paragraph.

drawings.notes:
ONE GRAPHIC BLOCK, FIVE STACKED REACTIONS. The whole scheme is a single embedded image spanning page y 526-2088, x 313-1441, recorded here as one 'scheme' drawing with five arrows so that arrow-to-structure references stay unambiguous. The five reaction rows occupy page y 526-766, 792-1067, 1088-1373, 1389-1712 and 1739-2040 respectively. Read left to right within a row, top to bottom between rows.

ARROW POSITIONS. Every one of the five arrows is a plain solid arrow with NOTHING written below it: the reagents_below array is empty in all five cases and that is a measured observation, not an omission. Only rows 1, 3 and 4 carry an above-arrow label ('cat', '碱/酸', '三乙胺/丙酮氰醇'); rows 2 and 5 carry no arrow label at all.

CO-REACTANTS ARE NOT ARROW LABELS. HBr and H2O2 (row 1), HOCH2CF3 and 碱 (row 2), cyclohexane-1,3-dione (row 4) and 氯化亚砜 (row 5) are written ON THE BASELINE to the left of the arrow, joined to the substrate by bold '+' signs, at the same height as the structures. They are drawn as co-reactants in the equation, not as reagents over an arrow, and have been recorded as structures rather than folded into reagents_above so that the distinction survives. Merging them into the arrow label would misrepresent the drawing.

Ring numbering used throughout this page: C1 is the ring carbon carrying the carbonyl (ester, acid, acid chloride or aroyl) group, and numbering runs from C1 towards the chlorine, i.e. Cl at C2. All four substituted positions were read off the drawn hexagon vertex by vertex, not inferred from any name.

SUBSTITUENT RENDERING. SO2CH3 is drawn out atom by atom at every occurrence (ring bond to S, two S=O double bonds, S bond to the label CH3), never abbreviated. CH2OCH2CF3 is drawn as a single bond from the ring carbon to a horizontal text label reading CH2OCH2CF3 with subscripted 2, 2 and 3; the internal connectivity of that group is given by the label text, not by drawn bonds. The methyl ester is drawn as the label H3CO bonded to a carbonyl carbon (H3CO-C(=O)-), the acid as HO-C(=O)-, the acid chloride as Cl-C(=O)-.

STEP ORDER AS DRAWN. Rows read: (1) benzylic bromination of the 3-methyl group, (2) etherification of the benzyl bromide with trifluoroethanol, (3) ester to acid, (4) acylation of cyclohexane-1,3-dione by the acid chloride, (5) acid to acid chloride. Row 5 makes the reagent that row 4 consumes, so the drawn order is not the chemical order; see discrepancies.

A tiny full-width full stop '。' is drawn at page x 317-323, y 2082-2088, below the last reaction row and inside the graphic block, at a much smaller point size than the body text. It appears to terminate paragraph [0029] but is baked into the image and is absent from the text layer.

ATTRIBUTION. [0028] immediately above reads 本发明所涉及的反应方程式如下 ('the reaction equations involved in the present invention are as follows'), so this scheme is the invention's own route. Nothing on this page is presented as prior art.

discrepancies.what: The scheme draws the acid chloride formation AFTER the reaction that consumes the acid chloride, so the drawn order is not the chemical order.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Reaction row 4 (page y 1389-1712) shows cyclohexane-1,3-dione plus the benzoyl chloride reacting to the final triketone. Reaction row 5, printed BELOW it at page y 1739-2040, shows the benzoic acid plus 氯化亚砜 giving that same benzoyl chloride. Row 5 therefore produces row 4's starting material.
discrepancies.text_says: [0025] lists the step 3) components in the order acid, catalyst, thionyl chloride, 1,3-cyclohexanedione, triethylamine, acetone cyanohydrin, which is the chemically sensible order and the reverse of the drawn one. Recorded as drawn; the page gives no explanation for the inversion and none has been assumed.

discrepancies.what: The catalyst named in the prose is drawn nowhere on the scheme.
discrepancies.drawing_says: No DMF and no 催化剂 label appears at any position in any of the five reaction rows. Row 5, where the acid chloride is formed, carries an entirely bare arrow.
discrepancies.text_says: [0025] gives a 催化剂 (catalyst) at 0.01-0.1 equivalents in step 3) and [0027] identifies it as DMF. A reagent written but not drawn.

discrepancies.what: The prose collapses into one numbered step what the drawing splits into two reactions.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Step 3) chemistry is drawn as two separate arrows: acid to acid chloride (row 5), then acid chloride plus cyclohexane-1,3-dione to product (row 4).
discrepancies.text_says: [0025], [0026] and [0027] treat step 3) as a single step with one combined molar ratio covering all six components. Neither representation is wrong, but a downstream pass that counts steps will get 3 from the prose and 5 from the drawing.

discrepancies.what: The scheme shows five transformations while the prose on this page numbers only three steps, and this page alone does not determine the mapping.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Five arrows: bromination, etherification, ester hydrolysis, acylation, acid chloride formation.
discrepancies.text_says: [0024] constrains step 2), [0025] to [0027] constrain step 3), and no paragraph on this page mentions step 1) or the ester hydrolysis of row 3. Rows 1 and 2 map plausibly onto steps 1) and 2) and rows 4 and 5 onto step 3), which would leave row 3 (hydrolysis) unassigned or folded into step 2). The mapping has NOT been resolved here because the paragraphs that define steps 1) to 3) are on earlier pages.

discrepancies.what: Reagents drawn on the scheme that no paragraph on this page mentions.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Row 1 uses HBr plus H2O2 with a catalyst labelled 'cat'. Row 2 uses HOCH2CF3 plus an unspecified 碱 (base). Row 3 uses 碱/酸 (base then acid).
discrepancies.text_says: None of HBr, H2O2, 'cat', HOCH2CF3, 碱 or 碱/酸 appears anywhere in [0024] to [0029]. They are drawn but not written on this page. The prose for those steps is on earlier pages and was not available to this pass, so this is flagged as unverified rather than as a conflict.

discrepancies.what: Two reagent names that DO appear in both places agree exactly, recorded here as a positive check rather than a conflict.
discrepancies.drawing_says: Row 4's arrow label reads 三乙胺/丙酮氰醇 and row 5's co-reactant reads 氯化亚砜. Row 4's left-hand structure is drawn as cyclohexane-1,3-dione (two C=O separated by one CH2).
discrepancies.text_says: [0025] names 氯化亚砜, 1,3-环己二酮, 三乙胺 and 丙酮氰醇. Drawing and prose agree on all four, including the 1,3 substitution pattern of the dione, which is read off the drawing independently.

discrepancies.what: The embedded text layer carries a character-spacing pattern the printed page does not, and omits a mark the printed page does carry.
discrepancies.drawing_says: The printed page shows no spaces inside '(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)' in [0025], and it does show a small '。' at page x 317-323, y 2082-2088 below the last reaction row.
discrepancies.text_says: The text layer encodes '(2 ,2 ,2-三氟乙氧基)' with a space before each comma while encoding '1,3-环己二酮' in the same sentence with none, and it contains no character at all for the small '。', which is part of the scheme graphic. The zh fields keep the text layer verbatim per the instruction for this born-digital document; both facts are recorded so a later reader can tell which is which.

illegible: Reaction row 4 arrow label, page x 832-988, y 1490-1526. The label is horizontally compressed to the point that adjacent glyphs touch (the dark-pixel column profile is saturated with no inter-glyph gaps from about x 895 rightwards). Six of the seven characters resolve cleanly as 三乙胺/丙酮 ... 醇. The sixth character, immediately before 醇, is over-inked: its enclosing 气 radical is unmistakable, including the sweeping top-left stroke and the lower hook, but the inner component is filled solid and its strokes cannot be separated at any threshold from 100 to 210. It is recorded as 氰, giving 三乙胺/丙酮氰醇, and the arrow is set to medium confidence. A reader who needs certainty on that one character should note that the reading is supported by, but not derived from, [0025] on the same page, which names 丙酮氰醇.
